mapper.select: select o.*, od.*, odo.*, m.member_name, m.member_email, i.image_src, p.product_name, CONCAT( SUBSTRING(m.member_tel, 1, 3), '-', SUBSTRING(m.member_tel, 4, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(m.member_tel, 8) ) AS member_tel, DATE_FORMAT(o.payment_date, '%Y.%m.%d.')
